decision_notes: The regional government bulletin explicitly lists dated Sejmik recordings and links the exact provider videos. Three distinct ordinary sittings (16 June, 2 July and 22 September 2026) were checked in Chromium and WebKit with decoded frames and advancing playback after introductions/recesses. Content observations include regional-state report debate, a named member speaking and debate on a regional assembly position. Exact institution Q8081138 is a Polish legislative body with jurisdiction Q54158. This is an official recorded-proceedings archive; current live and full committee coverage remain unverified.

Official government bulletin viewing link. Reviewed the bulletin reuse page and its scanned Marshal Order 21/25 of 25 March 2025, especially chapter 3, physical PDF pages 8-9: it sets procedures for reuse requests/offers and possible preparation costs. No specific prior-linking consent condition was identified in the reviewed material; no independent audiovisual redistribution licence was established. Retain personal-use permission pending, link out to the bulletin, and exclude from direct playback/IPTV.
